# leaseweb_object_storage_group (Resource)

Manage an object storage group

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage an object storage group
resource "leaseweb_object_storage_group" "readonly" {
  object_storage_id = "5c9d2a1e-3b47-4f8d-9e21-7a6c8b0d4f33"
  display_name      = "Read only"
  unique_name       = "read-only"

  s3_policies = jsonencode({
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"]
        Resource = ["arn:aws:s3:::*"]
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name of the group
- `object_storage_id` (String) ID of the object storage the group belongs to
- `unique_name` (String) Unique name identifier for the group

### Optional

- `s3_policies` (String) A JSON encoded IAM style policy document defining the S3 permissions for users in this group. Semantically equal JSON is treated as unchanged, so formatting & property order returned by the API do not cause a diff

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A group can be imported by specifying the object storage ID and the group ID in comma-separated format.
terraform import leaseweb_object_storage_group.example "5c9d2a1e-3b47-4f8d-9e21-7a6c8b0d4f33,8f3b1c70-2d94-4a15-b6e8-0c5d9a7e2b41"
```
